headline: Extract audio from video
intro: OtoNuki is a free iPhone and iPad app for extracting audio from video and converting audio files. Trim, merge or batch-convert files and save them as MP3, M4A or WAV.
extractBody: Choose material from Photos or Files and save it as audio. You can also convert several items at once.
editBody: Trim the sections you want to keep, or join several items in any order you like.
localBody: OtoNuki edits and converts imported files on your device without uploading them to the developer’s servers. Every feature is free, with no ads or account required.
requirements: Made for iPhone and iPad (iOS and iPadOS 17 or later)
helpIntro: We guide you from importing to saving, and explain what to check when conversion doesn't work.
startBody: From “Home”, import your material, select it and tap “Extract audio”. Choose a format and save, and the audio you created will appear in “Library”.
shareTitle: How do I use saved audio in other apps?
shareBody: In “Library”, open the menu for the audio you created and choose “Save to Files” or Share.
failureTitle: What if I can't import or convert?
failureBody: Check that the video has an audio track and that your device has free space. For material stored in the cloud, please wait for the download to finish. Items that failed to convert can be retried from “Progress”.
contactBody: Please tell us your device name, your OS and app versions, the file format, the steps you took and the error shown. You don't need to attach the original video or audio.
policyIntro: This policy applies to the OtoNuki app and to this official website.
processingBody: The app processes and stores the videos and audio you select, and the audio it creates, on your device. There is no feature for sending files to the developer's servers. If you choose material stored in the cloud, it may be downloaded from the original service so it can be imported to your device.
collectionBody: The app does not collect usage data and does not use data for advertising or tracking. No account registration is required.
controlBody: Material imported into the app and audio you have saved can be deleted within the app. Copies exported to Files or other apps are managed at their destination. Services you share to are covered by their own policies.
websiteBody: This website is published on GitHub Pages. GitHub records visitors' IP addresses for security. This website has no advertising or analytics tools.
policyContactBody: If you contact us by email, we use your email address and the message contents to reply to you and handle your inquiry. We retain them for as long as necessary to handle it. If you have privacy questions or would like to request deletion of the email address and message contents you sent us, please contact us at the address below.
marketingTitle: OtoNuki | Extract audio from video on iPhone and iPad
batchBody: Select multiple videos or audio files and convert them to the same output format in one batch.
mp3Use: Play and share on a wide range of devices and apps
